image_description: A single adult bison standing in a field of tall, dry grass with reddish-purple vegetation in the background. The bison is facing slightly towards the right, showcasing its massive shoulder hump, dark shaggy fur on the forequarters, and curved horns. The hindquarters are partially obscured by the tall grass.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, broad, and features distinct short, curved horns consistent with bison anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct beard of long, dark hair is visible hanging from the chin and throat area.
The eye visible on the right side of the face is dark and clearly defined.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and nestled within the thick fur of the head, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic massive build and high withers typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark fur, creating a very prominent shoulder hump.
The hindquarters are largely occluded by the tall foreground grass, making it impossible to verify the fur density accurately.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are visibly short relative to the massive size of the head and body.
The legs are completely obscured by the tall grass; hooves are not visible.
The tail is not visible in this angle/pose.
